text: Nia borrowed the little drum from Dalia, and she hoped to play a duet with Mateo. Nia said, “I need an answering beat.” Mateo said, “I am not ready for the audience.” Mateo said, “I can write a rhythm.” He wrote a rhythm on the paper with the pencil. Nia practiced Mateo's rhythm on the little drum. Nia played Mateo's rhythm on the little drum before Dalia. Mateo clapped, and Nia bowed. Nia said, “I want to play your rhythm again.” Nia put the paper between the little drum and the second drum.
